  • Method Details

    • isFullLine

      boolean isFullLine(Shop shop)
      Determines if the specified shop represents a full-line replacement. A full-line replacement indicates that no other rendering components will be processed for the same line, and rendering will proceed to the next line.
      Parameters:
      shop - the shop instance to evaluate, must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the shop is a full-line replacement, false otherwise

    • isFullLine

      boolean isFullLine(SignRenderSnapshot snapshot)
      Determines if a specific render component for a shop sign is designated as a full-line replacement. If it is a full-line replacement, this indicates that no other renderers will be processed on the same line, and rendering proceeds to the next line.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the SignRenderSnapshot containing data about the shop's current state, must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the render component is a full-line replacement, false otherwise
